QuestInfo.name: Making the Medicine
QuestInfo.0: #p404# in #m10003000# might know about a cure for a phobia of #o17#.
QuestInfo.1: I have my doubts about whether #p404# in #m10003000# truly knows anything about #o17#, but as he says, I should look for the materials needed to craft the medicine. I need to defeat #o14# and #o17# around #m10003000# and collect 10 #t4000014#s and 10 #t4000017#s.\r\n#rOnly characters at Level 17 or higher can complete this quest.#k
QuestInfo.2: I delivered the materials required to craft the medicine for the #o17# phobia to #p404# in #m10003000#.

0.0: I had no idea #p417# was still afraid of #o17#. Even so, there's no way a cure for a phobia of #o17# actually exists... Ahem... Never mind.
0.1: Well, fine. I don't know if this will work, but let's give it a shot. However, to make the medicine for the #o17# phobia, I'll need some materials. Don't tell me you're actually planning to gather them for me?

yes.0: You're more loyal than I thought. In that case, first I'll need you to bring me #b10 #t4000014#s and 10 #t4000017#s#k. You can get them by defeating #o14# and #o17# around Kerning City.

no.0: Heh, there's really nothing that suits this city less than showing unrewarded kindness to a neighbor.

1.0: Let's see if you've gathered all the materials I asked for. Hmm... Yep, no mistake about it.

item.0: Alright, let's try making that medicine to cure #p417#'s fear of #o17#. Go defeat #o14# and #o17# around #m10003000# and gather 10 #t4000014#s and 10 #t4000017#s.
